ausgang.diese-mappe-gibt-es: This folder doesn’t exist or you may not see it.

fotostapel.das-foto-ist-groesser: The photo is larger than 100 MB.
fotostapel.nur-fotos-als-jpeg: Only photos as JPEG or PNG can be taken over as a page.
fotostapel.zu-viele-fotos-auf: Too many photos at once – please finish one receipt first.
fotostapel.ein-foto-ist-nicht: A photo is gone (expired after two hours) – please take it again.
mailsuche.bitte-eine-gueltige-e: Please enter a valid email address, e.g. lena@example.org.
postfachoauth.den-e-mail-versand: Email sending via OAuth exists for Microsoft 365 and Google.
postfachoauth.fuer-anderer-anbieter-bitt: For “other provider”, please enter the authorisation and token endpoint as well as the scope.
postfachoauth.anbieter-microsoft-google-: Provider: Microsoft, Google or other provider.
postfachoauth.mandant-tenant-common-cons: Tenant: “common”, “consumers”, “organizations”, the tenant ID or the domain.
postfachoauth.bitte-die-client-id: Please enter the client ID (application ID).
postfachoauth.fuer-diesen-anbieter-ist: No app has been entered for this provider yet (client ID). See the manual “Mailboxes”.
postfachoauth.das-client-geheimnis-ist: The client secret can’t be read with the current key. Please enter it again in the Workbench.
postfachoauth.fuer-die-anmeldung-im: For signing in in the browser, Ablago needs its address (Workbench → Email and address). Without a public address use the device code.
postfachoauth.fuer-die-anmeldung-im-2: For signing in in the browser, Ablago needs an https address (http only for localhost). Without https use the device code.
postfachoauth.zu-viele-offene-anmeldunge: Too many open sign-ins. Please try again in a moment.
postfachoauth.die-anmeldung-ist-abgelauf: The sign-in has expired or is unknown. Please start again in the Workbench.
postfachoauth.die-anmeldung-hat-eine: Another person who administers Ablago started this sign-in.
postfachoauth.die-anmeldung-wurde-in: The sign-in was started in a different browser. Please start again.
postfachoauth.dieser-anbieter-bietet-kei: This provider doesn’t offer a device code. Please sign in in the browser.
postfachoauth.der-anbieter-hat-keinen-2: The provider issued no device code: {kurz}
postfachoauth.der-anbieter-nennt-keine: The provider gives no valid address for the device code.
postfachoauth.kein-offener-geraetecode-f: No open device code for this mailbox. Please request a new one.
postfachoauth.der-geraetecode-ist-abgela: The device code has expired. Please request a new one.
postfachoauth.warte-auf-die-anmeldung: Waiting for the sign-in with the provider …
postfachoauth.das-postfach-wurde-inzwisc: The mailbox has been signed out in the meantime. Please sign in in the Workbench.
postfachoauth.die-anmeldung-des-postfach: The mailbox’s sign-in has just changed. Please try again.
postfachoauth.das-postfach-ist-nicht: The mailbox isn’t signed in via OAuth. Please sign in in the Workbench.
postfachoauth.die-anmeldung-gehoert-zu: The sign-in belongs to a different provider. Please sign in again.
postfachoauth.die-anmeldung-ist-abgelauf: The sign-in has expired or was revoked – please sign in again in the Workbench.{wert}
postfachoauth.das-aktualisierungstoken-i: The refresh token can’t be read with the current key.
postfachoauth.der-anbieter-hat-kein: The provider delivered no refresh token (offline_access missing?).
postfachoauth.der-anbieter-hat-die-2: The provider didn’t renew the sign-in: {kurz}
postfachoauth.die-anmeldung-ist-abgelauf: The sign-in has expired or was revoked – please sign in again in the Workbench. ({grund})
postfach.ohne-verschluesselung-gehen-pas: Without encryption, password and mails go over the network in plain text. Please confirm explicitly.
postfach.nach-dem-uebernehmen-verschiebe: After taking over: move, mark as read or delete.
postfach.bitte-den-benutzernamen-des: Please enter the mailbox’s user name.

postfach.anbieter-microsoft-google-oder: Provider: Microsoft, Google or other provider.
postfach.oauth-2-0-nur: OAuth 2.0 only with encryption (SSL/TLS or STARTTLS).
postfach.bitte-das-passwort-bei: Please enter the password (with many providers an app password).
postfach.server-port-oder-verschluesselu: Server, port or encryption changed: please enter the password again – the saved one only goes to the previous server.
postfach.anmeldung-per-oauth-abgelehnt: Sign-in via OAuth refused: is the user name right (the mail address of the signed-in account)? Does the app have the permission for IMAP (Microsoft: IMAP.AccessAsUser.All), and is IMAP switched on for the mailbox?
postfach.anmeldung-abgelehnt-benutzernam: Sign-in refused: user name or password is wrong. Many providers require an app password.
postfach.server-nicht-erreichbar-adresse: Server can’t be reached ({wert}). Check address and port.
postfach.zertifikat-ungueltig-oder: Certificate invalid or encryption doesn’t match ({wert}). Check encryption and port (SSL/TLS usually 993, STARTTLS usually 143).
postfach.die-anmeldung-per-oauth: Sign-in via OAuth is not set up.
postfach.das-passwort-des-postfachs: The mailbox password can’t be read. Please enter it again in the Workbench.
postfach.server-port-oder-verschluesselu: Server, port or encryption changed: the saved password only goes to the saved server. Please enter the password again or save first.
postfach.bitte-zuerst-speichern-und: Please save first and then sign in with the provider.
postfach.server-port-oder-verschluesselu: Server, port or encryption changed: please save first and then sign in again with the provider – the token only goes to the saved server.
postfach.verbunden-im-ordner-liegen_one: Connected. There is 1 mail in the folder “{ordner}”.
postfach.verbunden-im-ordner-liegen_othe: Connected. There are {anzahl} mails in the folder “{ordner}”.
postfach.doppelt-liegen-schon-in_one: Duplicate: {map} is already in Ablago – check before assigning.
postfach.doppelt-liegen-schon-in_other: Duplicate: {map} are already in Ablago – check before assigning.

leerseiten.ohne-recht: This package does not have the right “Mark blank pages in new post” (dms:leerseiten).
leerseiten.andere-datei: The file of “{name}” has changed in the meantime – please check the current file.

leerseiten.liste.seite: seiten: whole numbers from 1 to {seiten} only.
leerseiten.wahl-nur-menschen: Whether a page stays or goes is chosen by a person – packages only mark.
leerseiten.versendet: All pages stay in sent emails.
